title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Enterprise security update: inference hooks GA, EDR sensor support in Cowork (beta)
bullets.summary: Anthropic made prompt and pre-tool-call inference hooks generally available, added a security center and centralized management at admin.claude.com (beta), and added EDR sensor support in Cowork on macOS/Windows (beta).
bullets.how: The Construct: GA pre-tool-call hooks are a native place to enforce guardrails on scheduled routines and the Mac runner. PRAGMA: concrete governance/security selling point for client agent deployments. Brand 9 Signs: indirect.

bullets.title: Claude Marketplace adds 25+ partner agents/products (Glean, Runway, Datadog, Zoom, Checkmarx)
bullets.summary: Anthropic's marketplace now lists 25+ partner products and lets committed Anthropic spend be applied to them.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: a distribution and procurement channel for AI-operator offers. The Construct: Runway listing is worth checking for video gen next to Higgsfield. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Mistral Studio managed agents enter public preview
bullets.summary: Agents SDK, visual workflow builder, apps CLI and evals are in public preview, with private cloud and on-prem deployment due late November.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: on-prem/private-cloud option for clients who cannot use US-hosted agents. The Construct: comparison point for our own orchestration layer. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Perplexity Teammates and Cursor cloud agents: always-on agents that ship work
bullets.summary: Perplexity launched Teammates (always-on work agents, Max subscribers on web) and Cursor's cloud agent can now build and deploy live web apps with database and auth provisioning.
bullets.how: The Construct: validates the always-on scheduled-agent pattern; benchmark against our routines. Brand 9 Signs: Cursor-style app deploy could speed quote/order micro-tools. PRAGMA: competitive landscape for operator offers.

bullets.title: Qwen3.8-27B runs locally in Microsoft Foundry Local as an agentic coding model
bullets.summary: Reported 73.0 on Terminal Bench 2.1 and 61.7 on SWE-bench Pro, wired into GitHub Copilot via BYOK (single secondary source, unverified).
bullets.how: The Construct: a small local model for cheap, private routine work; test on the Mac before trusting benchmarks. PRAGMA: on-device option for privacy-sensitive clients. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Governance is becoming a product surface: GA inference hooks, EDR in Cowork and marketplace procurement mean agent deployments are judged on controls, so build hook-based guardrails into The Construct's routines now and sell them as part of PRAGMA engagements. (Caveats: sourced from daily aggregators plus Anthropic release pages; no verified signage/CRM/DAM/real-estate MCP news, and no xAI/DeepSeek/Cohere launches found, so those are omitted.)
